start: A saved workout named 'Push 1' with the note 'Felt strong, shoulder ok'

user_sees: Under the Time / Kg lifted / Sets / Records row, the note 'Felt strong, shoulder ok' exactly as typed
must_not: The note cut, reworded or missing
The day type shown in place of the saved name

steps.action: Open the page's menu and tap 'Share as text'
user_sees: The phone share sheet with text starting 'Here is my workout from MettleUp...', 'Workout: Push 1', and a 'Workout notes' part with the note
must_not: The note missing from the text
Blank lines or odd line breaks inside the note

start: Another kind: an imported Hevy workout whose note starts with its own title

steps.action: Open the imported workout 'Leg Day' whose note reads 'Leg Day' then 'Squats felt heavy'
must_not: 'Leg Day' shown twice (title and first note line)
The rest of the note lost

start: Another way in: the finish screen's 'Text' share button, and the History list menu

user_sees: The share sheet with the same workout text and notes
must_not: Different notes from the workout page

steps.action: In History open a workout's menu and tap 'Share as text'
user_sees: The same text for that workout
must_not: Another workout's notes in the text

start: A workout with no note, or a note of only spaces and blank lines

user_sees: No note line at all under the stats
must_not: An empty grey box or a blank gap

user_sees: No 'Workout notes' part in the text
must_not: A 'Workout notes' heading with nothing under it

start: The member edits the workout's name or note after saving

steps.action: Edit the workout, change the note, save, open the page again
must_not: The new note's first line hidden because it matches the name by chance without saying so

start: Who sees the notes: the member shares the workout as text

steps.action: Tap 'Share as text' and pick a chat app
user_sees: The text holds the notes the member wrote, sent only where the member picks
must_not: Notes sent to the gym, a trainer or MettleUp by this action
